description.narrative: Revised PDO is to improve the livelihoods of smallholder cocoa and coffee producers supported by the project.

The development objective of the Productive Partnerships in Agriculture Project for Papua New Guinea is to improve the livelihoods of smallholder cocoa and coffee producers through the improvement of the performance and the sustainability of value chains in cocoa-and coffee-producing areas. There are three components to the project. The first component of the project is institutional strengthening and industry coordination. The objective of this component will be to improve the performance of sector institutions and to enhance industry coordination in the coffee and cocoa sectors. Existing stakeholder platforms for industry coordination will be consolidated to address short- and long-term issues such as sector governance, skills development in the industry, improvement in extension services, industry strategy on threats to quality and quality promotion, information within the industry, market development and crop diversification. The second component of the project is productive partnerships. The objective of this component will be to increase the integration of smallholder producers in performing and remunerative value chains, by developing and implementing productive alliances between smallholders and the private sector aiming at improving market linkages in the project areas. The third component of the project is market access infrastructure. The objective of this component will be to improve market access for smallholder cocoa and coffee growers in the areas targeted under the project.

title.narrative: Number of hectares of cocoa replanted or rejuvenated with improved planting material and applying improved practices

comment.narrative: <p>A total 11,946 hectares were rejuvenated or replanted with improved planting material and applying improved practices at the project completion compared to the project target of 15,000 hectares (80% of the target achieved achieved).</p>

title.narrative: Km of rural roads rehabilitated and maintained as per Maintenance Agreements

comment.narrative: <p>A total of 121 Km of rural roads was rehabilitated at the completion of the project compared to the project target of 115 Km (105% of the target achieved).</p>

title.narrative: No. of women benefiting from improvements in production, marketing & livelihood, including participation in functional literacy/numeracy & nutritional improvements linked to farming-as-a-business & ma

comment.narrative:
<p>The number of women benefiting from improvements in production, market access & livelihood was 50,706 at project completion compared to the project target of 40,000 (127% of the target achieved). </p>
<p><em>* Please note there is a error in the indicator name which should read market access not marketing. </em></p>

title.narrative: Number & coverage of partnerships implemented and/or scaled-up and likely to be sustained

comment.narrative: <p>There were 57 partnership likely to be sustained at the end of the project (114 % of the target achieved) of which 30 were in the coffee sector and 27 were in the cocoa sector.</p>

<p>A total of 60,494 smallholder farmers benefited from the project compared to the project target of 60,000 (101 % of the target achieved). There were 4,567 female beneficiaries from the project target of 24,000 (19 % of the target achieved). </p>
<p>Note: During the 2014 Additional Financing, the number of beneficiaries as an indicator was added as a corporate requirement. </p>

title.narrative: Number of hectares of coffee applying improved management practices.

comment.narrative: <p>The number of hectares of coffee applying improved management practices of recycle and maintenance pruning was 7,629 hectares at the project completion compared to the project target of 15,000 hectares (51% of the target achieved).</p>

title.narrative: Number of hectares of cocoa planted with diversified crops

comment.narrative: <p>The number of hectares of cocoa planted with diversified crops was 8,545 hectare at the project completion compared with the project target of 7,000 hectares (122 % of the target achieved).</p>

<p>The cocoa yield among project beneficiaries was 1,249kg/ha at the project completion compared to the project target of 600kg/ha (208 % of the target achieved).</p>

<p><em>Note: Metric ton as the Unit of Measure was incorrectly input in the system. The correct measure and reporting in the ICR is kilograms/hectare.</em></p>

<p> </p>

<p>At project completion the coffee yield among beneficiaries was 853kg/ha compared to the project target of 600kg/ha (142 % of thetarget achieved).</p>
<p><em>Note: Metric ton as the Unit of Measure was incorrectly input in the system. The correct measure and reporting in the ICR is kilograms/hectare.</em></p>

title.narrative: Net income of smallholder cocoa growers (in PNG Kina)

comment.narrative: <p>The net income of smallholder cocoa growers was K2,618 at project completion from the project target of K1,800.00 (145% of the target achieved).</p>

title.narrative: Net income of smallholder coffee growers (in PNG Kina)

comment.narrative: <p>The net income of smallholder coffee growers was K3,832.00 at project completion compared to the project target of K3,700.00 (104 % of the target achieved).</p>

title.narrative: Number of policy, strategy, and regulatory measures adopted or implemented

comment.narrative: <p>Ten (10) policy and strategies and regulatory measures were adopted or implement from the project target of six (6) (167 % of the target achieved). </p>

title.narrative: Supported coffee farmers receiving at least 10% quality premiums

comment.narrative: <p>The supported coffee farmers receiving at least 10% quality premiums was 6.5% at project completion compared to the project target of 20% (33% of the target achieved).</p>
